findings.title: No regression test for --select parent+ includes dynamically spawned descendants
findings.evidence: Grep of tests/*.test.ts found no test exercising the parent+ select operator with spawned children. playbook-loop-seed.test.ts uses --select improve+ on a statically-known task. codex-real-runner.test.ts uses --select=hello (no + operator). The --select parent+ operator is a critical DAG feature with no dedicated coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test in tests/playbook-dag.test.ts that creates a playbook with a seed that spawns dynamic children, runs --select parent+, and asserts all descendants are included in the selection.

findings.title: run.mode deprecation warning repeated per task node
findings.evidence: node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook self-improvement-loop --dry emits the same deprecation warning 13 times — once per task node instead of once at load time.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate or emit the warning once in the playbook loader, not per-task evaluation.
findings.regression_check: node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook self-improvement-loop --dry 2>&1 | grep -c 'deprecated' should be 1
